pending_interview.category: Case/product sense — client scoping walkthroughs, articulating tradeoffs out loud, build-vs-buy reasoning
pending_interview.question: A regional hospital network approaches you to evaluate whether to build a custom AI model for prioritizing inbound patient referrals, or to buy and integrate an existing third-party solution. They have a data science team of four people, a legacy electronic health records system that has no modern API (an API is a standard way for software systems to talk to each other), and a compliance team that has never reviewed an AI vendor contract before. Walk me through how you would structure that decision — what questions do you ask first, what tradeoffs are you weighing, and how do you know when you have enough information to make a recommendation?
